posts.text: @phreakv6 has covered most of the story well. Just adding some more data/insights below based on my look at the ARs and the export data: Export data I had collected the export data till 2025 and couldn’t collect more as the regulators recently stopped export data. Here are my observations: Venus is the largest Indian exporter of Meropenem ex-US. Aurobindo is the largest exporter to US via its subsidiary Eugia.
